init_detector_model: init a DetectorModel with a config path, checkpoint file, and minimum bounding box score threshold
get_bboxes_refine: get refined bounding boxes for an image by matching detected person bboxes against existing ones using IoU
compute_iou: compute the intersection over union between two bounding box coordinates as a float value
run_object_detection: run object detection inference on an image using mmdet and filter results by person class and confidence score
review_DetectorModel: review the DetectorModel class and its methods for bounding box detection and IoU-based refinement logic
